faqs.q: Do McDonald's and Burger King serve beef in India?
faqs.a: No. Out of respect for local food habits, McDonald's in India serves no beef or pork, and Burger King has kept beef off its Indian menu since it opened in the country. Their burgers in India are mostly made with chicken or vegetarian patties such as potato and paneer.

faqs.q: Is the Big Mac available in India?
faqs.a: No. Because the Big Mac is a beef burger, McDonald's sells the Maharaja Mac in India instead, with chicken and vegetarian versions built in a similar double-decker style. Menus also include many India-only items, so dishes you see in American reviews may not be available here.

faqs.q: Why do Burger King burgers taste different from McDonald's burgers?
faqs.a: The main difference is how the patties are cooked. Burger King flame-grills its patties, which gives them a smoky, charred flavour, while McDonald's cooks its patties on a flat griddle for a softer, more uniform taste. Bun size, sauces and toppings also differ between the two chains.

faqs.q: Which is healthier, McDonald's or Burger King?
faqs.a: Neither chain is a healthy everyday choice, as most burgers, fries and shakes at both are high in calories, fat, salt or sugar. If you eat there, grilled items, smaller portions and water instead of fizzy drinks are lighter options, and both chains publish nutrition information so you can compare specific items.
